intent: Rich’s father once kept my family’s generator alive through an ice storm and refused payment, so I am not asking Rich to abandon him. I saw two smaller movements deeper in the trees behind the large figure, and I have heard strangers tracking Gravitas drones toward delivery sites. We will draw Dad back to a controlled point, but Rich stays behind a wall while I watch the roads and listen for anyone else closing in.
emotion: protective, firm, personally invested, and careful about uncertainty
